name: District portals — bank branch lists (Sherpur, Jamalpur, Netrokona)
notes: No licence stated; the lists are undated. Only landline numbers are kept (mobile numbers dropped: Sherpur 5, Netrokona 14); no e-mails (none is a government address), managers' or contact persons' names, routing numbers or coordinates. Repeated entries left out: Sherpur: 'অগ্রণী ব্যাংক লিমিটেড , শেরপুর , শেরপুর' repeats the entry 'অগ্রণী ব্যাংক লিমিটেড , শেরপুর' (same e-mail and number); Jamalpur: '২৮। জনতা ব্যাংক লিঃ, জামালপুর প্রধান শাখা।' is listed twice (kept once). Not used: Mymensingh (the DC portal's bank list is empty and its menu links only bb.org.bd), the Netrokona bank PDF (its text layer is a legacy non-Unicode Bangla font; the portal's own list is used instead).
